title: Bulb: over 30 seconds
summary: Minutes-long exposures for streaky clouds and empty streets.

blocks.note: M stops at 30 s. Bulb keeps the shutter open as long as you tell it.

blocks.text: Work out the time with a test shot
Minutes-long test shots waste time. Shoot a test at **ISO 6400** instead: it's 6 stops brighter than ISO 100, so the real exposure is **64 times** longer.
Using an ND filter? Work out the time

steps: Tripod down on firm ground. Compose, autofocus, then switch to **manual focus** so it can't change.
Find the time: a test shot at ISO 6400 and the same aperture, then multiply by 64 (table above). With an ND filter, use the ND calculator.
Mode dial to **B**. Set the aperture and **ISO 100** by hand (not Auto ISO).
Set the time on the camera's bulb timer, or use a remote: press once to open, again to close. Start a phone timer as a backup.
Don't touch the tripod. When it's done, check the histogram and adjust the time: twice as long is one stop brighter.

items: Long-exposure noise reduction takes a second 'dark' exposure just as long. Keep it on for single long shots, off if you're short of time.
Cold and long exposures drain batteries. Start with a full one.
People and cars that keep moving vanish from minutes-long exposures. Only things that stop stay.
Cars passing with headlights? Hold a dark card over the lens until they've gone; the rest of the exposure is unaffected.

after.text: Star trails: a single long exposure or many 30 s frames

steps: Compose and focus, then switch the lens to **MF**. Lens IS off.
Test shot in M: same aperture, **ISO 6400**, adjust the shutter until it looks right. Multiply that time by 64.
Turn the **Mode dial to B**. Set the aperture, then **ISO 100**. With Auto ISO the R10 uses ISO 400 in Bulb.
**MENU › Shooting 7 › Bulb timer › Enable**, and set the exposure time.
Press the shutter fully once. The exposure runs and stops by itself.
No bulb timer? Use the BR-E1 wireless remote (press to start, again to stop) or the RS-60E3 cable.
**Shooting 5 › Long exp. noise reduction:** Auto or Enable for a cleaner single shot. The camera then needs as long again to process.
canon-r10.note: The bulb timer only works in B, and switches off when you change mode.
